artworks.title: The Venetian Mast
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The cobblestone street is lined with buildings. Trees can be seen at the end of the street. A tall post with an ornamental top is in the center. The scene features finely detailed brushstrokes and etched lines depicting architectural structures and figures. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones. People are engaged in various activities, such as sewing. Other figures and structures can be seen in the distance, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Doorway and Vine
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image features a large, rectangular archway leading to an interior space. The perspective is focused on the archway and building structure. The doorway is centrally placed. The etching technique is used with fine, linear strokes for texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, in sepia or brown tones. The space close to us appears open and sparse, while a framed window is visible beyond the archway with some indistinct figures or objects inside. The left side of the building is adorned with what seem to be vines or foliage.

artworks.title: San Biagio
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a low perspective scene near water with a boat at the bottom. The horizon is marked by the water's edge and stone structures. A large architectural arch is central, leading toward buildings and a street. The artwork features light and intricate brushstrokes, with a monochromatic color palette of earth tones and sepia. Faint outlines of figures near the archway suggest subtle activity in a canal-side setting.

artworks.title: Turkeys
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 20.96 x 13.02 cm (8 1/4 x 5 1/8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 21.27 x 12.7 cm (8 3/8 x 5 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with architectural features and animals. The image depicts a stone or brick building with a staircase leading up to a doorway, surrounded by a rustic courtyard or garden area. There are sketches of birds scattered throughout the lower portion of the scene. The building is covered with foliage, giving an impression of an old, well-worn structure. The line work is delicate yet confident, conveying a sense of both detail and atmosphere in capturing this setting.

artworks.title: Fruit-Stall
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.7 x 14.92 cm (8 15/16 x 5 7/8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 23.5 x 14.92 cm (9 1/4 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a riverside scene. The etching shows a group of figures outside a rustic building with multiple small windows. A canopy or cloth is draped above them. Some figures are seated, while another figure is standing to the side. Below, there is a body of water with a small boat or dock visible, adding a serene atmosphere to the scene. The line work is delicate and light, emphasizing texture and capturing an everyday moment.

artworks.title: San Giorgio
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with sailboats, buildings, and a shoreline viewed from a raised vantage point. The horizon is high in the frame, with buildings and sailboat masts breaking the line against the sky. The sailboats are dispersed throughout, drawn with delicate lines. A lone boat is moored close to the shore, depicted with crosshatched strokes. The etching technique uses thin, dark lines on lighter paper, creating a monochromatic palette of beige and black, contributing to the maritime setting.

artworks.title: Nocturne: Palaces
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brownish-black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a street view from an angled perspective, looking down a quiet narrow alley or canal bordered by buildings on either side. The horizon is hidden by the structures that line the scene. The artwork is created with a textured technique using fine, linear brushstrokes that resemble etching, creating depth and shadow within the scene. Dark, dusky tones dominate the color palette, giving the image a monochromatic feel that emphasizes the structural lines and shading. Closest to us, the street bends gently, leading the eye towards a shadowy passage between the buildings, where lighter strokes indicate subtle architectural details. In the distance, the blurred termination of the street or canal suggests a sense of quiet and stillness, drawing attention to the play of light on the surrounding architecture.

artworks.title: Long Lagoon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.24 x 22.7 cm (6 x 8 15/16 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 16.99 x 22.86 cm (6 11/16 x 9 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with the horizon positioned about one-third of the way from the top. The view shows an expansive water surface with several tall masted ships on the horizon and a distant cityscape with recognizable landmarks. The artwork features linear brushstrokes or etches, creating a minimalist and sketch-like quality. The color palette is subdued, with soft sepia tones suggesting an aged photograph or a faint wash of color. The composition is sparse, emphasizing the tranquil atmosphere of the scene. The scene includes wooden posts and a small boat in the water.

artworks.title: The Bridge, Santa Marta
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a canal scene from an elevated perspective. People and boats are visible on the water. Buildings line the canal, leading the eye towards the horizon. The etching technique creates a sketch-like quality with fine lines suggesting details. The color palette is monochromatic, with warm tones on the paper and black ink for contrast. Figures attend to boats near the canal's edge, while others engage in activities near a bridge in the distance. Architectural features frame the urban environment.

artworks.title: Upright Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a waterway with boats and gondolas. People are gathered along a sidewalk near the water's edge. More boats are docked nearby. The skyline features buildings and architectural details, including a domed structure with spires and rooftops. Wispy clouds are visible above the horizon. The style uses linear etching with fine, varied lines to convey texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by a creamy beige tone.

artworks.title: The Riva, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.dimensions: sheet (includes tab with signature): 30.48 × 21.91 cm (12 × 8 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene with buildings, boats, and people. The buildings line the water's edge, and boats and gondolas float on the water. People are seen walking near market stands, and the architecture includes tall rectangular buildings reflecting on the water. The sketch-like lines convey movement and the color palette is monochromatic in shades of beige and brown.

artworks.title: The Balcony
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image depicts a building next to a canal in Venice. The point of view is from the canal, facing the building. There is no visible horizon line. The intricate architectural details such as balconies, arched windows, and walls are shown with delicate lines. The scene is in sepia tones, giving it a vintage look. There is a figure in a gondola near the building, and another figure further back. The style resembles an etching, with fine linework showing the building and its reflection on the water.

artworks.title: Fishing-Boat
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.56 x 23.18 cm (6 1/8 x 9 1/8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 16.51 x 23.18 cm (6 1/2 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This print presents a waterscape. Closest to us, the watery surface gently ripples, depicted by sparse lines. A boat occupies the central part of the print, floating on top of the water. The boat features a canopy of densely drawn lines that appear to be an abstract depiction of hanging fabric, or perhaps fishing lines or dry goods. At least one person is discernible, seated low on the boat. In the distance, other boats and buildings are visible. The horizon is halfway up the print, and the sky above the water is clear.

artworks.title: Ponte del Piovan
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.86 x 15.24 cm (9 x 6 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 23.5 x 15.24 cm (9 1/4 x 6 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a bridge scene viewed from a slightly low point. The horizon is not prominently visible. The composition features a canal, a bridge with intricate details, two figures on the bridge, ornate buildings, and a sparsely detailed sky. The color palette is monochrome with shades of sepia and brown. The etching technique uses fine lines to convey texture and depth in the water reflections and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Garden
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic, overgrown architectural structure. The structure has arched windows and detailed stonework. The perspective is direct and eye-level. The horizon is not visible. The etching has fine linear brushstrokes creating a textured appearance for the stone and foliage. In the foreground, there are steps leading up to a relaxed seated figure. In the background, the entryway of the building merges with shadows, suggesting depth. The color palette is sepia with varying density in the etched lines to highlight light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Rialto
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image displays a cityscape with a perspective from an elevated point. The scene shows a busy street with people moving among tall buildings. A clock tower stands in the distance at the top center of the composition. The intricate linework on the buildings creates texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with beige and dark brown tones dominating the etching. The street appears crowded and lively with figures moving through it. Detailed facades and awnings adorn the surrounding buildings, enhancing the sense of a bustling urban area.

artworks.title: Long Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with a wide waterway in the foreground. Viewed from above, the scene includes buildings of different heights along the horizon. A detailed building is visible on the left side, and boats are scattered in the water. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, giving a sense of movement. The color scheme is mainly sepia, creating an antique atmosphere. The style blends fine and gestural line work to depict the calm water and dynamic sky and urban elements.

artworks.title: Nocturne: Furnace
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene viewed through a window. The drawing depicts a richly textured surface, seemingly the roughness of an exterior wall, with a prominent window at its center. Inside the window, there's a scene of a room with a cloaked figure. The drawing utilizes varying intensities of cross-hatching to create light and shadow.

artworks.title: Quiet Canal
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 22.86 x 15.24 cm (9 x 6 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 23.65 x 15.56 cm (9 5/16 x 6 1/8 in.)

artworks.description: The image is an etching of a narrow canal scene. The perspective is elevated, showing the buildings on either side of the water. The architecture features ornate facades with arched windows and balconies. The etching lines are fine and sketch-like. The color palette is primarily sepia. A gondolier is navigating a gondola in the foreground, with the water reflecting the scene. The canal narrows in the distance between the receding buildings.

artworks.title: Salute Dawn
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 20.32 cm (5 x 8 in.)

artworks.description: The image shows a city skyline across a body of water. The structures of the city meet the water, with buildings and ships. The skyline displays tall spires and domes. Delicate lines depict the scene resembling a sketch, with minimalistic detailing. The color palette is various shades of brown, giving an antique look. Linear strokes represent water with subtle movement.

artworks.title: Lagoon: Noon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 12.7 x 20.32 cm (5 x 8 in.)
sheet (includes tab with signature): 13.49 x 20.48 cm (5 5/16 x 8 1/16 in.)

artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a body of water, distant land with buildings and trees, a large sailing ship in the foreground, smaller boats scattered in the water, figures on steps in the lower-right corner, and a sky with clouds. The artwork uses fine lines and soft brushstrokes in a monochromatic sepia color palette to show movement and texture.

artworks.title: Wheelwright
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint  on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered workshop or barn interior. The scene depicts a wide and open room with a wooden beam ceiling. Within the workshop, various tools and pieces of equipment can be seen scattered or leaning against the walls, including large wheels, beams, and saws. The composition is filled with wooden textures emphasized by the cross-hatching technique used for shading and depth. The drawing's details highlight the industrial nature of the space, with impressions of dynamic and human-like activity in the room, adding a sense of hustle and movement.

artworks.title: Temple
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a street scene viewed from an eye-level perspective. The horizon is not distinct, but the buildings suggest a skyline that flattens to the left. The etching is executed in a simple, sketch-like style with light lines and minimal shading. The lines capture the architectural details and surroundings with spontaneity and elegance. In the foreground, there is a horse-drawn cart next to a street lamp, and beyond are buildings with chimneys and windows, as well as some bare trees. The overall color palette is monochrome.

artworks.title: Lobster-Pots
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. J. Watson Webb in memory of Mr. and Mrs. H.O. Havemeyer
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of dome-shaped baskets and nets on the ground, with a simple horizon in the background. The color scheme is monochromatic with dark gray and black outlines on a light beige background. The objects are positioned in various groupings across the lower half of the image.
